products.title: Golf-Surf Club Sweatshirt
products.body_html:
Ride the Wave, Swing the Game

Slide into serious comfort and clean style with the Axxa Golf-Surf Club Sweatshirt. Whether you’re dialling in your swing at the indoor bay or catching sunset vibes with your crew, this sweatshirt is your go-to layer. Made with soft, breathable cotton-blend fabric, it’s got that cozy feel with a polished edge—perfect for those who like to move between the green and the beach with ease.

Featuring bold puff print graphics on both the front and back, the Golf-Surf Club logo pops with texture and style—bringing a fresh 3D look that stands out without shouting. No hood, no fuss—just straight-up steeze.

Key Features:

  • Puff Print Details: Raised, textured prints front and back give the logo a tactile, elevated feel.

  • Easygoing Fit: Clean crew neckline with a relaxed drop-shoulder design—style that moves with you.

  • Layer-Ready: Lightweight but warm enough to ride solo or layer up on breezy evenings.

  • Signature Axxa Vibe: The Golf-Surf Club logo brings the heat—surf soul meets golf swing.

Washing Instructions:

Keep your sweatshirt crisp:

  • Machine wash cold 

  • No bleach 

  • Lay flat to dry - air-dried is best to protect the puff print

  • Warm iron only if needed (avoid ironing directly on the puff print)

  • Skip the dry cleaner (save your cash for golf balls)

This isn’t just a sweatshirt—it’s your daily driver for golf, beach, and everything in between. The Axxa Golf-Surf Club Sweatshirt with puff print brings dimension, vibe, and attitude in every stitch.
